segments.text: Working in my yard.
I live in a house that has a small yard.
In my yard, there is some lawn and a garden.
There is also a sidewalk that leads to the front walk, and a driveway that leads to my garage.
Throughout the year, I work to maintain my yard.
During the summer, I cut the grass that grows in my yard using a lawn mower.
I like the smell of the grass that has just been cut, but it's better not to cut the grass too short when the weather is dry.
I also put water on the lawn and garden so that the grass and flowers can grow.
During the fall, I rake the leaves off the trees in my yard. I use a rake to collect the leaves from the lawn.
Then I put the leaves into bags. I can use the leaves to make fertilizer.
When I was a kid, I didn't like the job of raking leaves, but now I don't mind it.
At the end of the fall, before cold weather arrives, I remove flowers from the garden.
During the winter, there is no work to do on the lawn or garden because they're covered in snow.
But I need to keep the snow off my sidewalk and driveway.
Whenever it snows, I use a shovel to clear the snow off the sidewalk and driveway.
Sometimes it snows a lot; if I didn't shovel the snow, it would soon be impossible to get into my house.
During the spring, snow melts. I clean out my yard by sweeping away leaves and removing weeds from the lawn.
I also put flowers back into the garden.
It's nice to see them again after the long, cold winter.
When spring comes, the grass grows very quickly, so I need to cut the grass quite often.
Working in the yard can be very satisfying work.
At night, the lawn and garden are looking green and healthy.
